flit_framing_waveform.flit_layout: 16-byte flit carrying transaction header + data + CRC, striped across the differential lane pairs of the sub-link ('brick' = 8 pairs/direction).
flit_framing_waveform.transaction_framing: Read / write / atomic transactions are packetized into one or more 16-byte flits.
flit_framing_waveform.lane_placement: Flit bytes are striped round-robin across the sub-link's lane pairs; receiver de-skews before reassembly.
flit_framing_waveform.modulation: NRZ (Gen1-3) or PAM4 (Gen4) at the NVHS line rate.

link_training_sequence.lane_lock: NVHS lanes acquire bit/symbol lock (PAM4 four-level eye adaptation at Gen4).
link_training_sequence.de_skew: Per-sub-link lane de-skew aligns the 8 lane pairs.

link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.Down_to_Training: Reset deassertion / link enable starts NVHS training.
link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.Training_to_Active: Lane lock + de-skew + alignment complete; flits may flow.
link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.Active_to_Recover: Excessive CRC/replay or lane loss triggers retrain.
link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.Active_to_Sleep: Idle link enters a low-power state; exit re-trains/realigns.
link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.lane_deconfigure: A permanently failing lane is dropped; link width narrows.

reliability_waveform.crc_check: Each received flit's CRC is recomputed; mismatch flags a corrupted flit.
reliability_waveform.replay: The receiver requests replay; the transmitter retransmits the affected flit(s) from the replay buffer.
reliability_waveform.ack: Good flits are acknowledged so the transmitter can retire them from the replay buffer.

general_timing_rule: NVLink is serial NVHS signaling with an embedded recovered clock per lane; the 16-byte flit is the transaction/flow-control unit. Higher-level link state (Training / Active / Recover / Sleep) and replay are specified in flit/symbol times so they scale across generations (NRZ Gen1-3 -> PAM4 Gen4).

voltage_levels.modulation_gen1_3: NRZ (two-level) — eye opened by TX FFE + RX CTLE/DFE.
voltage_levels.modulation_gen4: PAM4 (four-level) — three stacked eyes; requires stronger equalization + a four-level slicer.
voltage_levels.signaling: NVHS differential; embedded-clock CDR at the receiver.
